in_sanskrit.name: Gohel
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's mountain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gohel एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Gohel is derived from the Marathi language. It is a name for a boy, meaning 'God's mountain'. This name is often given to a child who is believed to be strong and powerful, like a mountain.
